Or maybe I don’t… {{wi}}Being the only one who knows what really happened is just so hurtful.
Am I supposed to bear this secret for the rest of my life? I can’t even talk it over with anyone…
There’s no point thinking about this. At the end of the day involving others in this matter would only unnecessarily hurt them. I just need to tough it out.
It’s easier said than done. Annalie’s senses seem uncharacteristically sharp when it comes to bullshitting her for some reason. Maybe I should avoid the topic altogether? 
That could be even more suspicious…{{wi}}
